context:
Goal: each agent runs the least effort that keeps it accurate.
Problem (rule): you asked "Builder shd be sonnet medium no?" Main runs the builder on Sonnet high. Your 13:51 layout covered session rows only, so the builder row is untouched. Changing it edits a ruled table.
Based on (read): the retrospective's take: effort follows the lane's kind, because a failed review round costs more than the effort saved. Unmeasured.
Departs from: main, where the builder runs Sonnet high in every lane — options a and b change it.
Meanwhile: builders keep Sonnet high.
